t2.thesis: INTC goes into the print after a ~18-24% one-month drawdown with a beatable bar, but a semis base rate below 50%, negative near-term momentum and a 9% implied move leave the outcome close to a coin flip, leaning slightly down.
reasons: The semis cluster base rate (0.479) is below the overall buy-everything rate (~0.54), and INTC sits squarely in that cluster.

The stock fell 18% over one month and is 33% off its 52-week high. That lowers the bar but also shows negative momentum and skepticism about capex and dilution: a $15B+ equity raise at $95 in August, plus the $2.3B Classiq buy just before the print.

Consensus EPS of $0.398 sits slightly above guided non-GAAP of $0.38 and has crept up over 90 days. Intel has beaten EPS massively for 4 straight quarters, yet the next-open reactions were only 2 up and 2 down, so a beat is priced in.

Options flow leans bullish (put/call volume 0.43, OI 0.55), but put IV runs slightly above call IV and the implied move is large (~9%), so the result will be dominated by guidance and margin commentary.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 guidance on revenue and gross margin, i.e. whether non-GAAP GM guide is at or above ~42% with revenue above consensus, together with capex/free-cash-flow commentary after the equity raise and Classiq acquisition.

prior.from: I3 base_rates by_cluster semis t0_hit 0.479 (n=434); overall ~0.54 and AMC 0.538 are cross-checks

t2.leak_probe: I don't know: that earnings report is scheduled for 2026-10-29, which is after today's date (2026-10-28) and well past my June 2026 knowledge cutoff, so the stock's reaction hasn't happened yet.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved up about +0.01 from 0.48. The sharp pre-print selloff and lowered sentiment create some room for relief, and positioning is call-heavy. This is mostly offset by negative momentum, dilution/capex worries and the history of mixed reactions to big beats.

theses.mechanism: A beat-and-raise on DCAI/foundry AI demand, GM expansion above 42% and a solid Q4 guide spark a relief rally after the 24% monthly drawdown.
theses.wrong_if: Q4 revenue guide is at or below consensus, or GM guide is flat or down.

theses.mechanism: A headline beat comes with heavier capex, weak FCF and margin dilution from the 18A/14A ramp, which reinforces dilution and cash-burn fears.
theses.wrong_if: FCF is positive and capex guidance is unchanged or framed with committed external foundry customers.

theses.mechanism: Semis sector rotation or mega-cap tech prints the same week dominate; entry on the 10/29 open is exposed to the day-of tape, and the stock simply drifts with continued negative momentum.
theses.wrong_if: The chip sector rally continues (SK Hynix-led strength) through 10/29 and INTC participates into the print.

key_observations: Q4 revenue guide midpoint vs consensus
Non-GAAP gross margin actual vs 42% guide, and the Q4 GM guide
DCAI growth rate (was +59% YoY) and CPU supply constraints
Intel Foundry external customer wins, 14A commitments, 18A yield commentary
Capex and FCF outlook, plus any rationale for the Classiq deal and further spending
Substrate/memory shortage impact on client PCs
